name: terminal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
ex=json.loads(Path('TERMINAL-EXCLUSIONS.json').read_text())['excluded_exact_paths']
files={}
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if f.is_file() and str(f.relative_to(p)) not in ex:
  assert not f.is_symlink()
  files[str(f.relative_to(p))]=hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert 'frozen-after.json' in files
assert json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
s=json.dumps({'algorithm':'SHA256','files':files,'excluded_exact_paths':ex,'exclusion_reasons':'TERMINAL-EXCLUSIONS.json','scope':'All actual existing own-lane files at terminal child time, except three precisely named noncircular terminal exclusions. Includes every completed receipt/output, all helpers, copied inputs/sources, reports, plans, saved search response/failure, visuals, copied hashchain, frozen-before and frozen-after. No own guard ledger exists because GET0. No external paths read.'},indent=2)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'SHA256-MANIFEST.json'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert r.returncode==0
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(files),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'frozen_after_count':171,'mismatches':0,'excluded_exact_paths':ex,'final_disposition':'HOLD scientific; ordinary PASS; procedure FAIL;credit0','all_spawned_jobs':'synchronously reaped by enclosing immutable runner before its return'}))
